signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link. It works once, and only for a short time.
signIn.sentLead: If that address has an account, or can open one, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once. The email also has a six-digit code, for when the link opens in the wrong place.
signIn.codeLead: Using Akana from your home screen? Type the six-digit code from the email here. It works once, and only for a short time.
signIn.errorCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new email.
signIn.errorInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address. Please check it and try again.
signIn.errorSend: The link couldn't be sent just now. Please try again in a moment.
signIn.errorLink: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
signIn.errorBusy: Too many sign-in links were asked for just now. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
signIn.errorGoogle: Google sign-in didn't work just now. Try again, or use an email link.
signIn.privacy: No ad pixels. No third-party trackers.
